## 函数体证明目标

- `_SemaphoreDelete`：`annotated_C/src/_SemaphoreDelete.c`。

## 外部契约边界

本轮在下列导入契约处停止递归，不生成它们的实现 VC。逐项来源、revision 和所选接口见 `checks/verification-scope.json`；不能把它们计为本轮新完成的实现证明。

`KTaskWakeup`, `_KTaskWakeup`, `GetTaskWithIdnodeInfo`, `KTaskUnSetDelay`, `KTaskInsertToReadyVector`, `AssignPolicyInsert`, `RoundRobinRemainReadyVectorInsert`, `KTaskStateSet`, `KTaskStatSetAsReady`, `JudgeKTaskStatIsSuspend`, `DoubleLinkListRmNode`, `DoubleLinkListInsertNodeBefore`, `DoubleLinkListInsertNodeAfter`, `InitDoubleLinkList`, `IsDoubleLinkListEmpty`, `FreeId`, `RemoveObj`, `GetObj`, `IdGetObj`, `IdRemoveObj`。

`LinklistResumeAll` 调用 `KTaskWakeup` 选择 `semaphore_pending_head_ic`，其 before 是写 exstatus 后的 marked 状态。

既定模型/信任边界：`CONTAINER_OF_IDNODE_LINK`, `CONTAINER_OF_SEMAPHORE_ID`, `CONTAINER_OF_TASK_ID`, `CONTAINER_OF_TASK_SCHED`, `CriticalAreaLock`, `CriticalAreaUnLock`, `KTASK_ASSIGN`, `x_free`。

## 执行约束

按 `/home/xinra/qcp-binary-democases/AGENTS.md` 指定的 verification-orchestrator 启动；当前工具需支持已有 trial 格式及外部库路径，不能把工程重组为 QCP_examples/Rocq 示例目录。符号执行、依赖分析、Coq 编译和 final-check 必须采用同一映射。

用户确认 review-passed 版本后，以上 predicate/spec 作为冻结输入。Annotation owner 可以添加或修正合法的 by local、call where、branch-control、Inv 和 multi-inv 等函数体注解，相关事实仍须证明，不得改可执行 C 行为或通过无依据假设消除义务。冻结语义需要修改时遵循 workflow 的审阅及审批流程。

仅按 controller 返回的 action 执行；不能用手工生成 VC 或编译绕过接纳。实现结束使用 controller final-check，另复核源码一致性记录是否仍有效。

## 本地待证义务

资源 view/strategy 的正确性、exstatus 写权限及 task map 重索引、Wakeup 队首与 ID 关联、循环和批量效果连接、ID found 资源恢复、注销与摘链中间态、SemaphoreRetired 到 SemaphoreRaw 转换均未由设计审阅证明。

当前源码/类型/接口证据见 `checks/review-261030/`；源码报告见 `.docs/Report/source-check-2026-10-30.md`。

specs.CONTAINER_OF_TASK_SCHED::<default>: With task_ptr Require addr_aligned(task_ptr, ALIGN_SIZE) && sched_link_ptr == sched_link_of(task_ptr) && emp Ensure __return == task_ptr && addr_aligned(__return, ALIGN_SIZE) && sched_link_ptr == &(__return->task_dync_sched_member.sched_link)
specs.KTaskWakeup::wakeup_by_id_ic: wakeup_by_id_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) Require id < 65536 && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure exists (task : Z) (desc : TaskDescriptorAbs) (after : VarGlobalState), task != 0 && get_task_with_idnode_success(sg, before, id, task) && before.os_tasks.task_desc_map(task) == Some(desc) && ((desc.tdSchedMember.tsmStat != TSK_SUSPEND && __return == -1 && after == before) || (desc.tdSchedMember.tsmStat == TSK_SUSPEND && __return == 0 && ktask_wakeup_step(task, desc, before, after))) && os_inv(sg, after)
specs.KTaskWakeup::detached_sched_null_delay: detached_sched_null_delay <= wakeup_by_id_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) Require id < 65536 && ktask_wakeup_detached_null_condition(sg, before, id) && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure exists (task : Z) (desc : TaskDescriptorAbs) (after : VarGlobalState), task != 0 && get_task_with_idnode_success(sg, before, id, task) && before.os_tasks.task_desc_map(task) == Some(desc) && desc.tdDelay == 0 && ((desc.tdSchedMember.tsmStat != TSK_SUSPEND && __return == -1 && after == before) || (desc.tdSchedMember.tsmStat == TSK_SUSPEND && __return == 0 && ktask_wakeup_detached_null_step(task, desc, before, after))) && os_inv(sg, after)
specs.KTaskWakeup::semaphore_pending_head_ic: semaphore_pending_head_ic <= wakeup_by_id_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) (sem task : Z) (rest : list(DL_Node Z)) Require id < 65536 && get_task_with_idnode_success(sg, before, id, task) && semaphore_pending_nodes(sem, before, cons(sched_link_node(task), rest)) && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure exists (desc : TaskDescriptorAbs) (after : VarGlobalState), __return == 0 && task != 0 && before.os_tasks.task_desc_map(task) == Some(desc) && desc.tdSchedMember.tsmStat == TSK_SUSPEND && wakeup_semaphore_head(sem, task, desc, before, after) && semaphore_pending_nodes(sem, after, rest) && os_inv(sg, after)
specs.KTaskWakeup::msgqueue_send_pending_head_: msgqueue_send_pending_head_ic <= wakeup_by_id_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) (mq task : Z) (rest : list(DL_Node Z)) Require id < 65536 && get_task_with_idnode_success(sg, before, id, task) && msgqueue_send_pending_nodes(mq, before, cons(sched_link_node(task), rest)) && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure exists (desc : TaskDescriptorAbs) (after : VarGlobalState), __return == 0 && task != 0 && before.os_tasks.task_desc_map(task) == Some(desc) && desc.tdSchedMember.tsmStat == TSK_SUSPEND && wakeup_msgqueue_send_head(mq, task, desc, before, after) && msgqueue_send_pending_nodes(mq, after, rest) && os_inv(sg, after)
specs.KTaskWakeup::msgqueue_recv_pending_head_: msgqueue_recv_pending_head_ic <= wakeup_by_id_ic With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) (mq task : Z) (rest : list(DL_Node Z)) Require id < 65536 && get_task_with_idnode_success(sg, before, id, task) && msgqueue_recv_pending_nodes(mq, before, cons(sched_link_node(task), rest)) && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure exists (desc : TaskDescriptorAbs) (after : VarGlobalState), __return == 0 && task != 0 && before.os_tasks.task_desc_map(task) == Some(desc) && desc.tdSchedMember.tsmStat == TSK_SUSPEND && wakeup_msgqueue_recv_head(mq, task, desc, before, after) && msgqueue_recv_pending_nodes(mq, after, rest) && os_inv(sg, after)
specs.LinklistResumeAll::semaphore_waiters: semaphore_waiters With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) (sem : addr) (waiting : list addr) Require list == semaphore_pending_head(sem) && semaphore_pending_nodes(sem, before, map(sched_link_node, waiting)) && os_inv(sg, before) Ensure __return == KOK && exists after, semaphore_resume_all_effect(sem, waiting, before, after) && semaphore_pending_nodes(sem, after, nil) && os_inv(sg, after)
